rubrics.justification: Generally matches a very poor-quality early cavitating embryo with absent/indistinct ICM and poor TE, but it is somewhat inconsistent about cavitation and adds uncertain image-specific details not firmly supported from a single still image.
Integrates age, BMI, AMH, PCOS, prior miscarriage, partner age, semen parameters, and endometrium reasonably well with embryo prognosis, though some links are broad rather than case-specific.
Overall logic is understandable, but there are internal inconsistencies in prognosis estimates (5-15%, 15-25%, 5-12%) and some mixed statements about ovarian reserve and stimulation strategy.

Largely consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF counseling, emphasizing poor morphology, realistic expectations, luteal support, and cautious use of add-ons; minor deviations include speculative comments about OHSS/high estradiol without supporting data.

Provides practical next steps for proceeding with transfer, counseling, luteal support, and future-cycle evaluation including metabolic optimization, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and discussion of PGT-A, though some recommendations remain somewhat general.
